Showcase: Workshop Desk

Why it exists

Workshop Desk is both a user-facing example and a real browser/native regression fixture. It exercises a large multi-Form project rather than a toy single-control demo.

What to inspect

Open it in Studio and switch Forms, use the Object Inspector, structural editors, Tabs, Table/TreeView, Panel, Picture/Shape/PaintBox, Timer/StatusBar and project resources.

What it proves

Repository tests compile and run it, stress it in Chrome, validate layout, and check the current integrated native Ready component surface without widening the formal beta.32 claim.

Open Workshop Desk sourceOpen Patch StudioDesigner tutorial

Suggested learning order

  1. Hello World
  2. Counter Window
  3. Checkbox Window and Combo Window
  4. Change capabilities
  5. Workshop Desk
  6. Only then move into the formal examples if you need the assurance pipeline.
